source_headlines: Missing girl, 5, found dead in Fort Pierce body of water - WPBF
novel_facts: Timeline details: reported missing at 11:39 a.m., found at about 3 p.m.
Father told police the pond was across from their apartment and she loved water
Mother lives in Haiti, expected to arrive Sunday
Girl had a tablet that was pinged but not recovered, family used it to try to locate her
Statistics on autism-related drowning deaths in Florida in 2025 (39 cases) and expert commentary on drowning risk
Description of search efforts: drones, Port St. Lucie bloodhounds, St. Lucie County Sheriff's dive team
